cap: Labor starts as a fetal cascade. Placental CRH drives fetal ACTH, and the fetal adrenal makes cortisol and DHEA-S, which the placenta turns into estrogen. Estrogen raises oxytocin receptors, connexin 43 gap junctions and prostaglandins, and the Ferguson reflex keeps oxytocin flowing. Induction copies this: dinoprostone, misoprostol or a balloon ripen the cervix, and oxytocin drives contractions. Excess oxytocin causes tachysystole and, in dilute fluid, hyponatremia.
